cases.topic: IN settings, subplan ownership and legacy null policy
contracts_checked: Trailing optional Settings keeps older three-child callers valid. TSubplans::Add retains defaults, and its sole direct TSubplanEntry allocation passes the new settings. Logical copying preserves settings.
Legacy HasNull is a Boolean recursive null test; the type annotator accepts any computable input. Legacy collection-null handling remains separate from ANSI handling.
limits: C09/C11 touch shared settings plumbing and must be reconciled once when integrating. C10 remains a separate ANSI NaN fix.

contracts_checked: HasNull returns required Bool and tests null presence without relying on reflexive equality, preserving NaN as a present value.

cases.topic: Imported IN type contract and checked-pointer API
contracts_checked: Root build discovered const auto* deduction from GetTypeAnn; source independently confirms the return is TCheckedDerefPtr<const TTypeAnnotationNode>, not a raw pointer.

Changing only const auto* to const auto preserves checked dereference and implicit conversion to the IsSqlInCollectionItemsNullable raw-pointer argument. Other added pointer deductions use APIs returning actual pointers.
The imported result setting is typed before consumption; its contained result is checked as Bool or Optional<Bool>. The fallback compares lookup and collection-item types.
limits: Original reviewed commit does not compile. Root owns the one-line correction and subsequent rebuild; this review makes no build-success claim.

contracts_checked: Write mode lookup is guarded by callable, child count, Kikimr sink, list, tuple size and atom checks.

Routing runs after compilation of the complete statement AST and before optimization, changing both optimizer enablement and YqlSelect expansion. The configuration object is shared with SessionCtx; ordinary host Reset restores it unless KeepConfigChanges is explicitly requested.
limits: This intentionally uses existing whole-query lowering. KeepConfigChanges can retain optimizer fallback as it already can for sampling; this is a quality/session-behavior consideration, not a demonstrated result regression.

cases.topic: Join filter inlining before non-spilling copy expansion
contracts_checked: The moved rule declares types, metadata and parent requirements. It removes residual filters on a successful rewrite, so the later rule is idempotent on those joins.
The early pass runs before physical index reads and CBO, while the relevant producers still have logical Copy support.
limits: The previously stated block-enabled/post-CBO Lookup sharing gap was retracted after exact lifecycle analysis; see C31-sharing-lifecycle-reassessment.json.
Separate archived nullable/keyless identity and general nonrepeatable-producer restrictions are not claimed fixed by C31. Native verification remains pending.

contracts_checked: Both the trigger and the tuple decoding branch require avg, preserving arbitrary tuple-valued aggregates when another aggregate has an AVG state.
Traits and output/input type accessors are unchanged APIs.
limits: Mixed AVG plus tuple aggregates still require native finalization and empty-input controls.

contracts_checked: IntervalType removes optionality before accessing a data slot. Its returned raw pointer and the added builder declarations match their definitions.
Interval and Interval64 use integral Decimal(35,0) sums and Uint64 counts, while non-interval AVG retains its prior cast path.

Final decimal-backed tuple states recover the original input type through the existing union/partial-aggregate binding map; its map strips optionality, and the finish path separately retains optional state handling.
DISTINCT padding strips optionality before calling GetAggregationType, so the added data-slot access is not applied directly to an Optional node at that call site.
limits: Original interval type recovery and optional/empty split aggregation require native coverage; source reasoning alone does not establish runtime casts or overflow limits. C24/C34 touch adjacent state handling and need semantic integration review.

contracts_checked: The widened map allocates fresh IUs and updates copied bindings without mutating memoized producer bindings. The producer-kind gate is the only removed restriction.
Existing union correspondence and nullable StablePickle paths consume the adjusted edge bindings.
PeepHoleOptimizePhysicalStages accepts the same rvalue stage vector, retypes the root if needed, replaces stage programs and returns a newly topologically sorted graph.
When focused lowering cannot finish, full peephole intentionally restarts from the original vector rather than mixing rewritten and original stage graphs.
limits: Full peephole may produce a different physical plan; fallback composite callable and block-shape controls remain native gates.

contracts_checked: Direct column resolution now requires the Member receiver to be the exact lambda row argument. Nested receivers retain their complete expression through existing materialization.
TCoMember construction remains guarded by the callable test, and lambda arguments follow the preexisting one-row lambda contract.
The mode detector uses the same guarded Write settings contract as C30 and checks the conditional update mode specifically.
Whole-query legacy lowering is chosen before optimization, preserving old/new row and explicit-index effect handling.
limits: The same explicit KeepConfigChanges persistence consideration as C30 applies.

cases.topic: Explicit index-read import, range/settings and lookup identity
contracts_checked: KqpRewriteIndexRead has the exact TExprBase, TExprContext&, const TKqpOptimizeContext& signature used; RBO already depends on the logical library containing the definition.
The reused lowering returns a covering TKqlReadTableRanges or a full-primary-key stream lookup over that read. The no-extra-columns call does not introduce an intermediate map/filter wrapper.
The imported key read allocates fresh IUs in base primary-key order, while requested result bindings remain attached to the table lookup. AllowNullKeys preserves nullable base primary keys.

Read settings are stored in a trailing constructor parameter with a default, retained by Copy and changed reconstruction sites, and parsed by the existing TCoNameValueTupleList overload at physical export.
A limited imported read cannot have a filter pushed beneath its limit; reads carrying nonempty settings are declined by lookup conversion that cannot retain those restrictions.
An imported explicit noncovering lookup lacks SourceRead, so MatchLookupJoinRightSide declines the path that synthesizes a replacement base read without its settings.
limits: Explicit-index controls must cover covering/noncovering, composite and nullable keys, limits, sorting and shared consumers. The broader inability to duplicate a physical TableLookup is not repaired here.

contracts_checked: The guarded detector selects replace, and upsert only when index stream maintenance is disabled, before metadata-dependent optimization.
The fallback uses existing default-filling/effect lowering and synchronizes IgnoreExpandPg.
limits: The same explicit KeepConfigChanges persistence consideration as C30 applies.

contracts_checked: ResolveStorageColumns returns no key when any physical key component is absent, instead of claiming uniqueness for a proper subset.
The noncovering lookup fetches fresh hidden IUs only for missing physical primary-key names; the original requested IUs are retained.
The change does not alter lookup input key ordering or manufacture duplicate storage columns.
limits: Late liveness and residual reconstruction must be verified together; hidden identity fields are internal and must not leak into result projection.

contracts_checked: GetIUType returns an actual const TTypeAnnotationNode*; paired exact annotation comparison is valid and conservatively includes optional/composite representation changes.
The marker is copied with physical properties, forces Grace before block eligibility is finalized, and causes metadata recomputation to suppress hash-distribution claims.

Both new connections are ordinary UnionAll: CommonBuildTasks keeps one partition, BuildUnionAllChannels requires one destination task, and the KQP task graph also leaves the default task count at one for ordinary UnionAll inputs.
Whole-root clearing removes saved CBO shuffle decisions and cached distribution before assignment. Subsequent ordinary joins can establish their own shuffles.
limits: Distributed native placement and nested-join controls remain required. Q07 fallback and C50 must share the persistent gather marker when integrating.
